name: Varian Wrynn
summary: Across the Great Sea, Varian Wrynn has vanished on the voyage to Theramore. His ten-year-old son Anduin wears Stormwind's crown under the guidance of Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and Lady Katrana Prestor.

sections.title: A Boyhood in Ash
sections.body:
Varian's boyhood ended when the First War shattered his life. He watched Garona Halforcen, the assassin, kill King Llane Wrynn as the Old Horde stormed the capital. Anduin Lothar rescued the orphaned prince and fled north with the kingdom's survivors to Southshore.

In Capital City, King Terenas Menethil II took Varian in like a second son. The young prince grew up in exile beside Prince Arthas Menethil, carrying the memory of his burned home. Then the Alliance of Lordaeron broke the Horde and reclaimed Stormwind.

sections.title: A Troubled Restoration
sections.body:
At eighteen, Varian took the crown and faced the immense task of rebuilding his ruined kingdom. He hired Edwin VanCleef and the Stonemasons Guild to restore the capital. When the great work was done, the corrupt House of Nobles refused to pay the promised wages.

The stonemasons would not back down, and Varian could not settle the dispute between the entrenched nobility and the furious artisans. Soon, violence filled Stormwind's streets.

sections.title: The Vanished King
sections.body:
Varian recently sailed from Stormwind toward Theramore Isle for peace talks arranged by Lady Jaina Proudmoore. He sought to ease tensions across the sea, but never reached the summit. During the crossing, the king vanished without a trace.

Stormwind is left vulnerable. Whispers of conspiracy spread through the court, and Highlord Bolvar holds the regency.

faq.q: Where is King Varian right now?
faq.answer: No one in Stormwind knows where Varian is. He vanished while sailing across the Great Sea to Theramore for secret diplomatic talks.

faq.q: Who is currently ruling Stormwind in his place?
faq.answer: Anduin Wrynn, Varian's ten-year-old son, holds the throne as child-king. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon carries the real administrative and military authority as regent, heavily influenced by royal counselor Lady Katrana Prestor.

faq.q: What troubled Varian's rebuilding of Stormwind?
faq.answer: When the Stonemasons Guild finished rebuilding Stormwind, the House of Nobles refused to pay the promised wages. Their dispute erupted into violent riots in the city's streets, and the exiled masons later became the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Why was Varian going to Theramore?
faq.answer: Varian was traveling to Theramore Isle at Lady Jaina Proudmoore's invitation for a high-level diplomatic summit. The talks aimed to ease hostilities between the Alliance and Thrall's Horde.

faq.q: How did Varian escape the First War?
faq.answer: After King Llane was assassinated and the Horde burned Stormwind, High Commander Anduin Lothar evacuated Prince Varian and the remaining civilian survivors by sea. They sailed north to Lordaeron, where King Terenas Menethil II took the young prince into his court.

faq.q: What was Varian's relationship with Arthas Menethil?
faq.answer: Varian and Arthas Menethil grew up as close companions and rivals in Lordaeron while Varian lived in exile. The two princes often sparred together. Arthas's descent into madness, the murder of his father Terenas, and his betrayal of Lordaeron turned their past friendship to bitter hatred.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you remember Varian as King Llane's beloved son, returned from exile to rebuild your home. His sudden disappearance casts dread over the realm.
As a warrior, you know King Varian trained with veteran knights and endured the horrors of the First War. Across the Alliance, he is admired as a formidable warrior and fierce martial leader.
As an Alliance member, you face a political vacuum with Varian absent. His absence emboldens dissidents and threatens border security from Westfall to Redridge.
